mentions.name: Spy Mission (Axiometa Genesis Mini adventure)
mentions.description: A real-world "spy mission" adventure game built for the author's granddaughter using an Axiometa Genesis Mini with modules to gate access. Players solve real-world challenges, enter the results into the Genesis device, and receive directions to the next challenge. Family members' specialties (entomology, mechanical engineering, etc.) are woven in so the granddaughter can elicit help from each person, culminating in a reveal of a secret planned activity (a theme park visit) the following day.
mentions.audience: A real-world game experience created for the author's granddaughter, with family members contributing their specialties.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm creating a "spy mission" for my granddaughter. Using an Axiometa Genesis Mini with some modules for gating access. Real-world challenges, enter results into the Genesis, get directions to the next challenge.
mentions.author: jagged-chisel
